tool.name: dotnet-stryker
tool.invocation: dotnet tool restore && dotnet stryker --config-file stryker-config.json

source.note: Analysis ran against the working tree at head commit 053f3eb with the Stage-3 test edits (Tests/Environment/TransitTests.cs, Tests/Environment/SimulationStepTests.cs) applied but uncommitted; the mutation-scoped files Environment/Simulation.cs and Environment/PerceptionFilter.cs are byte-identical to that commit.

results.scoreDefinition: (killed + timeout) / (killed + survived + timeout + noCoverage), as reported by Stryker ('The final mutation score is 99.61 %').

survivorClassifications.rationale: The mutated statement removes _agentLastSeenTicks.Clear() from Reset(). _agentLastSeenTicks is only ever read at line 201 inside the else-if guarded by _agentLastKnown.TryGetValue(...), and _agentLastKnown is cleared unconditionally at line 221; the two dictionaries are always written together (lines 195-196). Removing the line-222 clear therefore cannot change any observable post-Reset read. The prior artifact's rationale ('same dictionary already cleared at line 219') was wrong: line 219 clears _zoneLastSeenTicks, not _agentLastSeenTicks. Corrected here; classification unchanged.

nodeOpen = capacity > 0 && nodeLoad < capacity vs the mutant capacity >= 0 && nodeLoad < capacity. nodeLoad is a per-zone reservation count (initialized to 0, only incremented), so 'nodeLoad < 0' is always false: for capacity == 0 the mutant's nodeOpen is also false (identical outcome), and for capacity >= 1 both conjuncts agree. Verified: with this mutant applied to a clean tree, the full 419-test suite passes standalone (dotnet test, Release), and CliArgumentFuzzTests passes in three consecutive isolated runs. The raw clean Stryker run attributes a kill to CliArgumentFuzzTests; that attribution is a batch-mode artifact (the fuzz harness shares a temp workspace and only writes missing files, so concurrent worker runs race on file state) and does not reproduce. Remains an equivalent survivor.

The extra iteration rank == agentCount re-resolves the same agent as rank 0: AgentAtResolutionRank(agentCount, agentCount, t) = (2*agentCount - t % agentCount) % agentCount = (agentCount - t % agentCount) % agentCount = AgentAtResolutionRank(0, agentCount, t). That agent was already processed at rank 0; a claim it made is now in claimsSet (no double award) and a blocked/waiting/transiting agent is blocked again identically. Verified: with this mutant applied to a clean tree, the full 419-test suite passes standalone (dotnet test, Release, including the new ResolutionRotation_WrapRank_DoesNotDoubleAwardOrDoubleClaim test), and CliArgumentFuzzTests passes in three consecutive isolated runs. The raw clean Stryker run attributes a kill to CliArgumentFuzzTests; that attribution is a batch-mode artifact (shared temp workspace, concurrency race) and does not reproduce. The wrap-boundary test pins the boundary but cannot kill an equivalent mutant.

killedInThisCalibration.rationale: EdgeChoke's not-found sentinel 'return -1' flips to 'return +1', so a corrupt crossing over a missing choke would silently charge edgeLoad[1] instead of throwing. Previously NoCoverage (statusCounts NoCoverage 1 at the prior calibration). New test TransitAcrossMissingChoke_FailsLoudly_InsteadOfSilentlyChargingSiblingEdge (Tests/Environment/TransitTests.cs) drives agent 0 InTransit over a choke-less pair and asserts IndexOutOfRangeException; verified deterministic: with the mutant applied the test fails, with the base code it passes and asserts the loud failure. Genuine kill; tracked NoCoverage gap closed.

rawReport.runNote: This is the clean baseline: leftover fuzz temp state under /tmp/lattice-fuzz-cli-* was cleared before the run, and dotnet tool restore was rerun. A previous same-day run (StrykerOutput/2026-09-22.04-26-54) reported Killed 252 / Survived 2 / NoCoverage 0 (99.21%) before cleanup; its two 'fuzz-killed' attribution counts were the flaky survivors recorded here.

dispositionNote: Raw counts are transcribed from the Stryker JSON report by direct parsing, not estimated. The two Killed attributions to CliArgumentFuzzTests (mutants 258 and 309) are non-reproducible batch-mode artifacts of the fuzz harness's shared temp workspace and are classified EQUIVALENT_MUTANT with direct evidence: the full suite passes against each applied mutant. The one reproducible gain over the prior calibration is mutant 480 (EdgeChoke not-found sentinel), which moved NoCoverage -> Killed via the committed corrupt-transit test. The committed gate remains the stryker-config.json thresholds; per FINDING-005 the per-run HTML/JSON report is not checked in — this summary artifact is the committed machine-readable record of this calibration run.
